blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Procedural discussions over the public display of tax records arise before the Senate Impeachment Court as defense counsel Kristine Ferrer and private prosecutor Erwin Matib present their arguments on the disclosure of Vice President Sara Duterte’s tax documents, with the defense asking the court not to flash copies of her tax returns and related financial summaries on screens or displayed where the public could view them. /dp READ: LIVE UPDATES: Sara Duterte impeachment trial | Oct. 9, 2026...
